name: Pocket Pyro
blurb: Design your own fireworks show — tap the sky, pick burst styles, unleash the finale.

name: Orbit Runner
blurb: One-tap arcade: reverse your orbit to dodge red arcs and snag gold sparks as the ring speeds up.

name: FairShare
blurb: Split any bill by what each person actually ordered — tax and tip divided proportionally, pennies always add up.

name: TimeBridge
blurb: Pick your cities, see everyone's waking hours side by side, and tap the starred hour that works for all.

name: KaleidoDraw
blurb: Drag to paint glowing, ever-shifting kaleidoscope art with adjustable mirror symmetry — then save your bloom as a PNG.

name: CycleSleep
blurb: Enter your wake-up or bedtime and get the exact times that align with full 90-minute sleep cycles, so you wake up rested instead of groggy.

name: Emoji Alchemy
blurb: Combine emoji elements to discover 70+ hidden creations — and a built-in alchemy engine invents something new for literally any pair you try.

name: Burn Meter
blurb: A live-ticking dollar counter that shows exactly what a meeting is costing in real time, based on attendees' salaries.

name: Groove Grid
blurb: A pocket drum machine: tap the glowing grid to build beats with six synthesized instruments, swing, presets, and a smart randomizer.

name: Payoff Pilot
blurb: List your debts and instantly compare snowball vs. avalanche payoff plans — debt-free date, total interest, and a payoff curve, side by side.

name: Prism Path
blurb: A light-bending puzzle: place mirrors to steer coloured beams through splitters and filters until every target glows its exact colour.

name: Prism
blurb: A neon light-routing puzzle: flip mirrors and beam splitters to steer coloured lasers into every ring — mix red and green to make yellow, all three for white.

name: Batchwise
blurb: Paste any recipe and resize it by servings or pan size — quantities come back as fractions you can actually measure, with one-tap cups↔grams.

name: Lumen
blurb: Flip mirrors and beam splitters to route coloured light across a grid — 10 hand-built puzzles where red plus green really does make yellow.

name: Caffeine Curve
blurb: Log your coffees and see the real pharmacokinetic curve of caffeine in your bloodstream — including how much is left at bedtime and the last hour you can safely have one more cup.

name: Astro Putt
blurb: Nine holes of golf in deep space — slingshot your ball past gravity wells and repulsors, with a live trajectory preview that makes every bank shot plannable.

name: Crossover
blurb: Rent or buy? Watch two net-worth curves race each other and find the exact year buying pulls ahead — mortgage, taxes, upkeep, PMI and the investment return you give up, all in today's dollars.

name: Pace Ace
blurb: Enter any two of distance, time and pace and it solves the third — plus a split plan you can tune from negative split to fade, equivalent race times, and training paces.

name: Primordial
blurb: A living petri dish: five species of glowing particle obey nothing but a table of attraction numbers, and cells, chains and hunting swarms emerge on their own — tune the table and watch life change.

name: Plated
blurb: Tell it when you want to eat and it works backwards — every dish gets a start time, hands-on prep is spread so one cook can actually do it, and it warns you when the oven is double-booked.

name: Grainfall
blurb: A pixel sandbox where sand piles, water finds its level, oil floats and burns, and one drop of lava into the pool turns it to stone and steam.

name: Skyshift
blurb: Enter your flight and it builds a day-by-day sleep and bright-light schedule that shifts your body clock before you take off — so you land days ahead of the jet lag.

name: Echoes
blurb: A time-loop puzzle: rewind and a ghost of your last run replays every step, so you can be in two places at once — eight levels of holding your own doors open.

name: Kerf
blurb: Enter the pieces you need and the stock you can buy, and it packs them onto the fewest boards — kerf included, with a visual cut diagram and the exact marks to make.

name: Rungs
blurb: A word ladder puzzle: climb from one word to another one letter at a time, with only real-word swaps offered and a compass showing how many rungs are left.

name: Offer Lab
blurb: Put two job offers in the same currency — equity vesting, bonus, 401(k) match, PTO, commute time and cost of living all folded into one number, year by year.

name: Alibi
blurb: A noir deduction case: every guest gets a room, an item and a departure time, and a freshly generated set of statements that always has exactly one answer — pin the board, then name the thief.
